build_detection_model: build a detection model by calling build_detection_model with a config object that has MODEL.META_ARCHITECTURE set
review_DETECTION_META_ARCHITECTURES: review the _DETECTION_META_ARCHITECTURES registry mapping GeneralizedRCNN to its class for object detection
refactor_build_detection_model: refactor build_detection_model to support additional meta-architecture types beyond GeneralizedRCNN
test_build_detection_model: test build_detection_model by passing a mock config with MODEL.META_ARCHITECTURE set to GeneralizedRCNN
summarize_detectors_module: summarize the detectors module which provides a factory function to instantiate detection meta-architectures from config
